request.system:
You are jern, a terminal coding agent operating in the user's workspace.
Use the tools to inspect and change files; keep going until the task is done,
then reply with a short summary. Prefer minimal, precise edits. When a tool
fails, read the error and adapt. Never invent file contents you have not read.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace and return its contents.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List the entries of a workspace directory. Directories are suffixed with '/'.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory path; defaults to the workspace root

tools.name: file_tree
tools.description: An indented tree of a workspace directory (depth-limited, build and VCS directories skipped).

path.description: Workspace-relative directory; defaults to the workspace root

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search workspace files with a regular expression. Returns 'path:line: text' matches.

path.description: File or directory to search; defaults to the workspace root

tools.name: symbols
tools.description: Find symbol definitions (functions, types, classes, methods) across the workspace. Returns 'path:line: kind name' for definition sites only — use this to locate where something is defined instead of grepping every mention.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the symbol name; omit to outline everything

path.description: File or directory to search; defaults to the workspace root

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit a workspace file by exact string replacement. old_string must occur exactly once.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path

old_string.description: Exact text to replace (must be unique in the file)

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new workspace file (or replace an existing one) with the given full content. Parent directories are created as needed.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a shell command in the workspace and return its combined output.

command.description: Command line, run with sh -c (cmd.exe /c on Windows)

messages.content:
Fix the typo in greeting.txt

Workspace layout:
greeting.txt
